events.title: Wings & Kids Wizardry: A Real Life Owl Adventure
events.description: Step into a world of wizardry where owls deliver magic, wishes take flight, and every young wizard leaves with an owl of their very own! Join us for an unforgettable magical adventure featuring a LIVE OWL, enchanting games, sweet treats, spellbinding activities, and a very special Wishes Taking Flight Ceremony. 🦉 WINGS, WISHES & WIZARDRY 🪄 Young witches and wizards are invited to Sacred Ground for an afternoon where imagination, magic, and the mysterious world of owls come together! We’ll begin with an up-close LIVE OWL presentation, where kids will meet one of these incredible creatures, learn fascinating owl facts, enjoy magical treats and drinks, and have the opportunity for photos with our feathered guest. Then the wizardry begins! Each child will take part in a magical Sorting Hat experience to discover which special owl has chosen them. And yes—every participant gets to take their little owl home! But first, their owl needs a name…and a little magic. Using selenite, each young wizard will name and “activate” their owl, creating a magical companion to carry their wishes, dreams, and intentions. Throughout our adventure, kids will enjoy wizard-inspired games and activities, including a fun Quidditch-style releasing activity where we’ll practice the magic of letting go of something we no longer want to carry. Next, we’ll create Feather Wishes Scrolls, writing down the wishes and dreams we’d most love to send out into the universe. And for our grand finale… ✨ WISHES TAKING FLIGHT ✨ Together, we’ll gather for a special ceremony where our young wizards will release their wishes and send a little magic out into the world. Every child leaves with their own owl, their magical experience, and hopefully the feeling that sometimes the most powerful magic begins with a wish. 🦉 Live Owl Presentation 🪄 Wizardry & Magical Games 🎩 Sorting Hat Owl Assignment ✨ Name & Activate Your Owl with Selenite 🪶 Feather Wishes Scrolls 🌟 Wishes Taking Flight Ceremony 🍪 Magical Treats & Drinks 📸 Photos with the Live Owl 🦉 A Little Owl for Every Child to Take Home Space is intentionally limited so every young wizard can be part of the magic. Group Experience Maximum 14 Participants Grab your cloak, bring your imagination, and come ready for a little mischief, a little magic…and a whole lot of owl wizardry.
